recent_excerpts: CVE-2026-82923 (CVSS 9.8) lets unauthenticated attackers install plugins, write files, and achieve RCE in the AI Website Builder WordPress plugin 1.0.0. No patch yet.
CVE-2026-60004, a 9.8-CVSS Gitea RCE, is under active attack per CISA. Attackers with repo write access can run shell commands. Patch now.
CISA added CVE-2026-42271 (CVSS 8.7) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog after evidence of active exploitation against BerriAI LiteLLM deployments.
